versions.content: Compiler version and settings Type: valid Description: It SHALL be possible to describe the actual compiler (vendor, version), and its settings, which has been used for object code delivery or which needs to be used for source code delivery. Rationale: When BSW is delivered as object code the integrator needs to know how the object code has been compiled. If it is delivered as source code, the code is often provided for specific compilers and versions. Dependencies: – Use Case: Object code compiled with different compilers may have issues in the stack structure. Therefore the used compiler and its settings have to be described in order to detect such inconsistencies. Supporting Material: –
